Candidate_Estimand: Estimand A: Direct High-Pressure Value Added (R_HP)
What_It_Measures: Context-adjusted runs added per 100 balls specifically in high-pressure match situations
What_It_Does_NOT_Measure: Differential response to pressure (does not subtract low-pressure performance)
Potential_Bias_Risk: Selection bias if player is protected from extreme bowling attacks; sparse samples for fringe players
Extrapolation_Risk: Zero (evaluated strictly on observed high-pressure deliveries)
Interpretability: High: Exactly runs per 100 balls above context expectation in clutch moments
Statistical_Defensibility: Highest: Pure empirical Bayes shrinkage on target domain; no noisy slope magnification

Mathematical_Formula: theta_i = Cov(v_t, x_t) / Var(x_t) (with EB shrinkage)
Scoring_Subset: All pressure-eligible deliveries across all leverage levels
What_It_Measures: Marginal rate of improvement per unit increase in leverage relative to low-pressure baseline
What_It_Does_NOT_Measure: Absolute performance level (a below-average player who improves slightly gets high rank)
Potential_Bias_Risk: Severely noisy: requires estimating second-moment slope on small samples; penalizes players who are elite in all states
Extrapolation_Risk: High: assumes strict linearity across entire range of PI
Interpretability: Low: Abstract slope coefficient; not intuitive in runs or match outcome terms
Statistical_Defensibility: Low: Low SNR makes individual slopes statistically indistinguishable from zero

Candidate_Estimand: Estimand C: Baseline Linear Extrapolation (Current Model)
Scoring_Subset: All pressure-eligible deliveries, extrapolated to PI = 0.90 + KO adjustment
What_It_Measures: Estimated performance at 90th percentile of leverage via linear extrapolation + IPL knockout adjustment
What_It_Does_NOT_Measure: Actual observed performance in high-pressure moments (dominated by slope extrapolation and baseline)
Potential_Bias_Risk: Magnifies slope noise by 40x; penalizes players with tiny knockout samples (Abhishek docked -10.22 on 16 balls)
Extrapolation_Risk: Severe: extrapolates to PI = 0.90 where players have < 10% of their deliveries
Interpretability: Moderate: Runs per 100 balls, but composite of 4 distinct moving parts
Statistical_Defensibility: Moderate: Theoretically ambitious but fragile to noise and knockout sample sparsity

Scoring_Subset: All pressure-eligible deliveries, weighted continuously by delivery leverage L(s)
What_It_Measures: Leverage-weighted value added across all deliveries (higher-stakes balls naturally dominate)
What_It_Does_NOT_Measure: Does not apply a hard step-threshold at PI = 0.80
Potential_Bias_Risk: Low-leverage deliveries still carry minor weight (~15-20% of total weight)
Extrapolation_Risk: Zero: weighted average of all observed data without functional extrapolation
Interpretability: High: Runs added per 100 balls weighted by game importance
Statistical_Defensibility: Very High: Utilizes 100% of player deliveries while focusing on high leverage
